MAHALAGANG ABISO SA MGA MOTORISTA 🚦

Magkakaroon ng pansamantalang full road closure sa bahagi ng Cambridge Street mula K-9th Street, West Kamias hanggang Ermin Garcia Street, Brgy. E. Rodriguez, Quezon City para sa isasagawang konstruksyon ng “QCitizen Homes – Cambridge”.

Magsisimula ang road closure mula June 1, 2026 at inaasahang tatagal hanggang sa matapos ang proyekto sa Disyembre 2027. Ipapatutupad ito sa mga sumusunod na araw at oras:

• 8:00 PM hanggang 5:00 AM tuwing Lunes hanggang Sabado
• Buong araw tuwing Linggo at mga idineklarang holiday

Mananatili rin ang kasalukuyang one-way traffic scheme sa lugar.

Pinapayuhan ang mga motorista at residente na maglaan ng karagdagang oras sa biyahe at gumamit ng alternatibong ruta kung kinakailangan.

Maraming salamat sa inyong pag-unawa.

Breaking China’s Local War Scenario in the Spratly Islands with the ‘Type 12 SSM’ and ‘Klub’ Network

Currently, many people in the international community and inside China are being manipulated by Beijing’s sophisticated information operations and psychological warfare (cognitive warfare). The media is excessively hyping the possibility of armed conflict in the “Taiwan Strait” or around the “Senkaku Islands (Diaoyu Islands)”, but these are nothing more than China’s grand  diversionary operations (deception tactics). China’s true strategic ambition is to forcefully break through the “First Island Chain” that constricts it. And the most vulnerable “vital point” in that defensive network is considered to be the Spratly (Nansha/Truong Sa) Islands in the South China Sea. China is preparing an extremely dangerous scenario here: launching a lightning local war that leaves no room for international intervention, aiming to create a fait accompli in one stroke.

🅰️. The Japan-Philippines Counter-Strategy in Motion and the Shock of the ‘Type 12 SSM’However, the recent rapid defense rapprochement between Japan and the Philippines has precisely struck the heart of this sinister Chinese plot. Along with the upgrading of the comprehensive Japan-U.S.-Philippines security framework, Japan is accelerating defense equipment and technology transfers, while effectively building forward cooperation hubs in key positions in the South China Sea. What is shaking China the most is the Type 12 SSM (Type 12 Surface-to-Ship Missile, improved version) developed by Mitsubishi Heavy Industries.  

This next-generation missile reaches a range of approximately 1,000 km. When deployed along the line from the southwestern islands of Okinawa to northern Philippines, it completely locks down the entrance from the East China Sea to the South China Sea. Even more terrifying is its “barrel-roll maneuver” — performing a spiral rotation like a fighter jet just before hitting the target. This irregular supersonic maneuver completely neutralizes Chinese warships’ air defense networks and close-in weapon systems (CIWS), delivering overwhelming deterrence with the message: “Once locked on, interception is impossible.” China’s naval supply lines and reinforcement routes would be severed along this line the moment war breaks out. 

🅱️. Vietnam’s ‘A2/AD’ Network and the ‘Klub’ That Bring Ultimate RuinThe decisive factor that completely bankrupts China’s local war plan is the organic integration of Japan’s Type 12 SSM with Vietnam’s long-built high-level anti-access/area-denial (A2/AD) network. Vietnam has already completed a multi-layered short-to-medium range defense fire network, including the supersonic coastal defense missile K-300P Bastion-P (Yakhont) with a 300 km range, Klub (Club-S/N) missiles carried on Kilo-class submarines and Gepard-class frigates, and its own VCM-01, among others. (https://t.co/nHxlMtMoRA)

What deserves special mention is the containerized missile system Club-K (or its variants). This system can be disguised in ordinary cargo containers, allowing secret deployment even on Vietnam Coast Guard (CSB) patrol vessels, steel-hulled fishing boats, or civilian transport ships. As a result, the countless island reefs and vast waters of the Spratly Islands themselves transform into mobile missile bases.

 Multi-Directional Simultaneous Saturation Attack to Deter AggressionIf China commits aggression in the Spratly Islands, the west (from Vietnam’s mainland and waters) would launch surprise attacks with Klub and Yakhont from disguised containers or submarines. At the same time, from the east (Philippine and Japanese positions), the Type 12 SSM would strike with supersonic speed and irregular trajectories. For the Chinese Navy, this means facing unpredictable multi-directional simultaneous saturation attacks (saturation attack).

When the defensive capabilities and geographical advantages of Japan, the Philippines, and Vietnam cross over in this way, China’s sweet illusion of a “lightning local war” is literally crushed before it even begins. The hegemonic schemes of a petty power that disregards the rule of law will face complete bankruptcy in front of the unyielding network defending a free and open ocean.

 #SouthChinaSea #A2AD #Type12SSM #IndoPacific.

Footnotes

[1] The War Zone (TWZ), “Japan’s New Anti-Ship Cruise Missile Barrel Rolls To Evade Defenses” (Jan 2026) 
[2] CSIS Missile Threat, “P-800 Oniks/Yakhont/Bastion (SS-N-26)”
